checks.detail: Runtime: both host receipts bind candidate_source_sha256 594829ca7661 (native_candidate_matches true, source_unchanged true); fresh build, isolated native store, full webdriver session lifecycle, and replay interaction pass in two independent runs. Interface: all six signed-in surfaces, the anonymous auth shell, and an invalid-email error state (input preserved, actionable message) were captured and reviewed. Persistence: focusboard.sqlite3 observed in the isolated XDG root and rust-unit 50/50 includes register/verify/signin/quickadd restart persistence. Security: private-operation rejection, generic rate-limited auth failures, and single-use token tests pass; evidence is secret-free. Visual: calm editorial direction holds on every surface with no PRD 9 prohibited patterns; this loop's wrap fix is verified - completed rows keep controls on one line with the checkbox aligned in both runs, long titles wrap in place as PRD 9 permits, and the compiled bundle carries the nowrap/basis-0 rules with the narrow-viewport column override. Carried gaps are host-lane evidence debts (external deeplink receipt, per-step journey receipt, PRD 9.2 states), not candidate defects.

developer_outcome.summary: Shared-rule risk mitigated per risk_note: CSS-scoped change, build+unit pass (tsc+vite exit 0, cargo 50/50), structural assertions hold (compiled CSS keeps <=860px column stacking; nowrap + title basis 0 caps fixed controls ~740px under ~980px at 1280x800, forcing single-line rows). Final visual proof needs Host WebDriver recapture, so not_validated.

risk_note.summary: The wrap fix may be entangled with shared .task-main flex rules used by uncompleted rows and other surfaces, risking alignment regressions outside the completed-row state.
risk_note.validation: Most likely to end insufficient_evidence is the visual single-line verification, because developer-side WebDriver capture is unavailable and final proof depends on Host recapture; mitigation is a CSS-scoped change, build-plus-unit self-checks, and structural layout assertions in the developer report.
risk_note.why_now: It is the only candidate-owned active defect and the sole failed phase-gate gap, and the rest of the candidate baseline is frozen and validated, so this is the last blocker for phase closure.
